question: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution are traffic in human beings and beggar and other forms of forced labour prohibited?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 23**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 23** of the Indian Constitution prohibits traffic in human beings, beggar (forced labor), and other similar forms of forced labor.
 
• This Article is part of the Fundamental Rights enshrined in the Constitution to protect individuals from exploitation.
 
• Any contravention of this provision is punishable by law.
